user.title: Connect to Octopus Energy Service
user.description: Use the root URL reachable from Home Assistant (not /v1/home-assistant). Enter the local service token, not your Octopus API key. Use HTTPS on untrusted networks.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace service token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the new token for your existing local service. The old token is never shown.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure service connection
reconfigure.description: Change the root API URL and enter its service token. Existing entity IDs are preserved.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) root URL without user credentials, a path, query or fragment.
error.invalid_auth: The service token is missing, invalid or rejected.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the authenticated service snapshot. Check connectivity, TLS and the service. Redirects are not accepted.
error.already_configured: Another entry already uses this service URL.

abort.already_configured: This service URL is already configured.
